description: Generate strong thesis statement options for an essay from a topic, the essay type (argumentative, expository, analytical, compare-contrast), and an optional stance. No account or email needed. Use it when a student needs a thesis or essay direction.

email.description: Optional. The student’s email, only if they choose to give it. Not needed for the result.

examples: The impact of social media on teenage mental health

name: generate_thesis_statement
title: Generate essay thesis statements
